lines: Every candle that gutters still lit the whole room once,
so let the going out be its own kind of grace.
cards.meaning: On accepting endings without erasing what they gave.

lines: The river never asks the bank for permission to bend —
it simply finds the shape that lets it keep moving.
I have started keeping the porch light on
but so the dark has one thing to walk around.
सुना है लोग उसे आँख भर के देखते हैं
सो उस के शहर में कुछ दिन ठहर के देखते हैं
सुना है रब्त है उस को ख़राब-हालों से
सो अपने आप को बरबाद कर के देखते हैं
सुना है दर्द की गाहक है चश्म-ए-नाज़ उस की
सो हम भी उस की गली से गुज़र के देखते हैं
cards.meaning: I hear people gaze at her their fill, so I have stayed in her city a few days to look too. I hear she has a soft spot for the ruined and undone, so I am wrecking myself, just to see. I hear her proud eyes seek out pain, so I too pass through her lane, just to see.
